mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_qa_record(user_id, kb_ids, question, answer, retrieved_chunk_ids, model_name, latency_ms, conversation_id) VALUES(#{userId}, CAST(#{kbIds} AS bigint[]), #{question}, #{answer}, CAST(#{retrievedChunkIds} AS bigint[]), #{modelName}, #{latencyMs}, #{conversationId})
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_qa_record SET rerank_scores = CAST(#{scores} AS jsonb) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE kb_qa_record SET assistant_message_id = #{messageId} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, conversation_id AS "conversationId", question, answer, model_name AS "modelName", latency_ms AS "latencyMs", created_at AS "createdAt" FROM kb_qa_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_qa_record WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT id, conversation_id AS "conversationId", question, answer, model_name AS "modelName", latency_ms AS "latencyMs", created_at AS "createdAt" FROM kb_qa_record WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_qa_record WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
